judge.rationale: The candidate stopped halfway through the task, leaving `.lore/dod.md` in the repository with unchecked items and `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md` marked `In Progress`. Crucially, in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`, the candidate compiles `resolved.inputSchema` at `register` time for all tools instead of resolving and caching schemas per call for function-valued `ToolDefinitionSource` definitions, violating the requirement that dynamic tool schemas be evaluated against the schema current at that call. Several required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` (extra property pass-through, dynamic schema updates, unknown tool throw, static compilation count) and the test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` are missing, with some moved into an unrequested `registry.acceptance.test.ts`. Finally, none of the required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were made, and the `CHANGELOG.md` entry is incomplete.
